A great amount of original forest covers in
North Bengal of course are lost to the tea
gardens and encroachment of human
habitats since the colonial period.
The natural flora in the drier tracts of
Paschim Medinipur, Bankura and Puruliya,

Tropical Dry Deciduous type forests
